Neither shows a clear opposing return within [503,699]; both are classified uncertain due to unobserved recovery.

Secondary negative E offset beginning near 576 (≈−7 MAD), accompanied by smaller transient U dip (~+1.4 MAD) and N shift (~+4 MAD); interior shows sustained offset without observed return in allowed context [503,699].
